attackers_goals: Execute arbitrary commands on the host and gain a larger foothold.
description: A contained process attempted to escape the host by leveraging the Docker's 'notify on release' feature. The calling process modified relevant files that might trigger a command on the host.
investigative_actions: Check which commands were executed on the host afterward. Look for the root cause of the execution within the container. Examine the release_agent script content on the container.
name: A contained process attempted to escape using the 'notify on release' feature
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
